const renderTooltip = (props) => ( Pdf ); const renderExcelTooltip = (props) => ( Excel ); const renderPrinterTooltip = (props) => ( Printer ); const renderRefreshTooltip = (props) => ( Refresh ); const renderCollapseTooltip = (props) => ( Collapse ); const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(new Date()); const handleDateChange = (date) => { setSelectedDate(date); }; const MySwal = withReactContent(Swal); const showConfirmationAlert = () => { MySwal.fire({ title: 'Are you sure?', text: 'You won\'t be able to revert this!', showCancelButton: true, confirmButtonColor: '#00ff00', confirmButtonText: 'Yes, delete it!', cancelButtonColor: '#ff0000', cancelButtonText: 'Cancel', }).then((result) => { if (result.isConfirmed) { MySwal.fire({ title: 'Deleted!', text: 'Your file has been deleted.', className: "btn btn-success", confirmButtonText: 'OK', customClass: { confirmButton: 'btn btn-success', }, });
